documents.title: Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Jubilant Agri And Consumer Products Limited Has Informed To The Exchange About Update On Capacity Addition.

analysis.summary: Jubilant Agri and Consumer Products Limited reported consolidated revenue from operations of INR 4,852 million and EBITDA of INR 325 million for Q4 FY26. Performance was driven by double-digit revenue growth in Adhesives and P&K Fertilizers, though industrial polymers and Agri Nutrients faced headwinds. Management highlighted that its new Polymer manufacturing facility in Samlya, Gujarat is set to commence in Q1 FY27. Additionally, the Board approved a Scheme of Arrangement to demerge the company's Agri Division into Jubilant Agri Solutions Limited. Jubilant Agri and Consumer Products Limited reported consolidated revenue from operations of INR 4,510 million for Q3 FY26, up 13% year-on-year.

guidance.claim: The company will commence operations at its polymer manufacturing facility in Samlya, Gujarat, in Q1 FY27.
guidance.quote: Company will commence its state of the art Polymer (adhesive) manufacturing facility at Samlya ( Gujarat) in Q1 of FY27.

guidance.claim: Domestic construction demand continues to strengthen, which supports strong growth prospects.
guidance.quote: Domestic construction demand continues to strengthen, supporting strong growth prospects

guidance.claim: The company remains focused on profitable and volume-led growth through innovative product launches and channel expansion.
guidance.quote: Focus remains on profitable, volume-led growth through new innovative product launches & channel expansion

guidance.claim: Pricing in Performance Polymers & Chemicals is expected to normalize by Q1 FY27.
guidance.quote: Higher input costs for certain raw materials pressured EBITDA margins, but pricing is expected to normalize by Q1 FY27

guidance.claim: Management expects input costs to remain stable in Q3 FY26 while maintaining focus on demand generation through strategic A&P spends.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic construction demand remains stable, supporting growth prospects for adhesives.
demand_outlook.quote: Stable domestic construction demand, supporting growth prospects

demand_outlook.claim: Demand for replacement tyres and tyre cord fabrics slowed across domestic and global markets.
demand_outlook.quote: Replacement tyres and tyre cord fabrics witnessed a slowdown in demand across both domestic and global markets

demand_outlook.claim: Softness in demand was observed across industrial polymers, food polymers, and industrial chemicals.
demand_outlook.quote: Industrial polymers, Food polymers and Industrial chemicals faced demand softness

demand_outlook.claim: The adhesives business maintained double-digit revenue growth despite a slightly softer demand environment in primary markets.
demand_outlook.quote: The company sustained double-digit revenue growth despite a slightly softer demand environment in the key markets

demand_outlook.claim: Urban housing demand expanded due to increased renovations and modular furniture adoption.
demand_outlook.quote: Urban housing demand uplifted driven by rising renovations and modular furniture adoption

demand_outlook.claim: Demand for replacement tyres and tyre cord fabrics slowed down in both domestic and international markets.
demand_outlook.quote: Replacement tyres and tyre cord fabrics witnessed a slowdown in demand both domestic and global in market

demand_outlook.claim: Industrial and food polymers experienced demand softness owing to USA tariff uncertainty.
demand_outlook.quote: Industrial and Food polymers faced demand softness due to USA tariff uncertainty but gained share in other regions

demand_outlook.claim: Favourable monsoons and positive agricultural sentiment led to high double-digit revenue growth in Agri Products.
demand_outlook.quote: Favourable monsoons and strong agricultural sentiment across key markets contributed to high double-digit revenue growth

demand_outlook.claim: Increased renovation activity and adoption of modular furniture are driving growth in urban housing.
demand_outlook.quote: Rising renovation activity, increasing adoption of modular furniture driving growth in urban housing

demand_outlook.claim: Benign interest rates and enhanced liquidity are driving accelerated expansion in the construction sector.
demand_outlook.quote: Accelerated expansion in the construction sector driven by benign interest rates and enhanced liquidity

demand_outlook.claim: Favorable monsoons and strong agricultural sentiment contributed to high double-digit revenue growth in Q2-FY26.
demand_outlook.quote: Favourable monsoons and strong agricultural sentiment across key markets contributed to high double-digit revenue growth in Q2-FY26.

demand_outlook.claim: Approved subsidy under the Nutrient-Based Subsidy scheme for Rabi 2025–26 is expected to strengthen fertilizer affordability and offtake.
demand_outlook.quote: INR 37,952 crore subsidy approved under the Nutrient-Based Subsidy (NBS) scheme for Rabi 2025–26, with higher support for phosphorus and sulphur nutrients, likely to further strengthen fertilizer affordability and offtake

capex_expansion.claim: The company will start operating its Polymer manufacturing facility at Samlya, Gujarat in Q1 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Company will commence its state of the art Polymer (adhesive) manufacturing facility at Samlya ( Gujarat) in Q1 of FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: A world-class R&D center at the Samlya plant enables the development of a new SBR latex product range.
capex_expansion.quote: World-class R&D center at the Samlya (Gujarat) plant facilitates the development of new range of SBR latex

capex_expansion.claim: The company expanded its Agri product portfolio and entered the bulk fertilizer segment with NPK 20:20:0:13.
The Board approved expanding Performance Polymers manufacturing capacity by setting up a facility at Samlya, Vadodara.
capex_expansion.quote: Board of Directors of the Company, at their meeting held on Tuesday, November 04, 2025 approved the expansion of its Performance Polymers (WWA and SBR Latex) manufacturing capacity of the Company by setting up a manufacturing facility at its Samlya (Savli), Vadodara site.

capex_expansion.claim: The proposed capacity addition for Performance Polymers is 30,000 MTPA.
The proposed capacity addition requires an investment of approximately INR 50 Crores.
The Board approved a capex of approximately Rs. 50 Crs to set up new manufacturing facilities for the Performance Polymers and Chemical segment at Samlya, Vadodara.
capex_expansion.quote: Board of Directors of the Company, at their meeting held on Tuesday, November 04, 2025 approved CAPEX of ~ Rs. 50 Crs for expansion of its Performance Polymers and Chemical segment by setting up new manufacturing facilities at its Samlya (Savli), Vadodara Gujarat site.

margins_costs.claim: Input cost pressures emerged in March 2026, managed through timely pricing actions and higher raw material inventory levels.
margins_costs.quote: Input cost pressures emerged in March 2026; however, timely pricing actions and higher raw material inventory levels enabled the company to effectively manage short-term supply disruption while managing the margins

margins_costs.claim: The company is mitigating input cost inflation through calibrated price increases and strategic sourcing.
margins_costs.quote: Input cost inflation persists; mitigating impact through calibrated price increases and strategic sourcing

margins_costs.claim: Higher costs for raw materials and packing materials negatively impacted EBIT margins in Performance Polymers & Chemicals.
margins_costs.quote: Higher input costs for certain raw materials and packing materials impacted EBIT margins

margins_costs.claim: Sulphur and Acid prices experienced a sharp increase due to ongoing geopolitical disruptions.
Lower input costs helped support EBITDA margins in the Adhesives segment.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margins were supported by lower input costs

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins in Performance Polymers & Chemicals were impacted by elevated input costs for specific raw materials.
margins_costs.quote: Higher input costs for certain raw materials pressured EBITDA margins, but pricing is expected to normalize by Q1 FY27

margins_costs.claim: An increased mix of value-added products aided revenue performance and margins in Agri Products.
margins_costs.quote: An increase in value-added product mix supported better margins and revenue performance

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins for adhesives remained healthy due to lower input costs.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margins remained healthy supported by Lower input cost

margins_costs.claim: Margins in the industrial polymer and food polymers businesses were impacted by subdued demand.
margins_costs.quote: Industrial polymer and Food Polymers margins impacted due to subdued demand

margins_costs.claim: The chemical business achieved high double-digit revenue and EBITDA growth driven by better realizations.
margins_costs.quote: Chemical business recorded high double-digit value growth in Revenue and EBITDA, due better realisations

orders_capacity.claim: The total installed capacity for Polymers and Chemicals stands at 80,000 MTPA, while Single Super Phosphate capacity is 400,000 MTPA.
orders_capacity.quote:
Polymers and Chemicals: 80,000 MTPA
Single Super Phosphate: 400,000 MTPA

orders_capacity.claim: The company's total existing capacity across Polymers and Chemicals stands at 80,000 MTPA.
The current total capacity utilization is approximately 79%.
The planned capex will expand the manufacturing capacity of the Performance Polymers business by 30,000 MT per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: The capex will be funded mostly through internal accruals and will increase the manufacturing capacity of Performance Polymers business by 30,000 MT per annum.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's installed capacity for Polymers and Chemicals stands at 80,000 MTPA.

capital_allocation.claim: Working capital deployment was increased for off-season placement, with liquidation expected by Q1 FY27.
The Board approved a Scheme of Arrangement for the demerger of the Agri Division into Jubilant Agri Solutions Limited.
capital_allocation.quote: The Scheme, inter alia, provides for demerger, transfer and vesting of the Agri Division i.e. the Demerged Undertaking (as defined in the Scheme) from the Demerged Company into the Resulting Company on a going concern basis

capital_allocation.claim: The capacity expansion for Performance Polymers will be financed through internal accruals.
The Board of Directors approved a demerger of the Agri division into Jubilant Agri Solutions Limited.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of Directors of the Company at its meeting held on November 04, 2025, approved the Scheme of Arrangement for demerger between Jubilant Agri and Consumer Products Limited (“The Demerged Company”) and Jubilant Agri Solutions Limited (“The Resulting Company”) and their respective shareholders and creditors, under the provisions of Section 230-232 and other applicable provisionsof the Companies Act, 2013 and the Rules made thereunder (“Scheme”).

capital_allocation.claim: The expansion capex for the Performance Polymers business will be funded primarily through internal accruals.
capital_allocation.quote: The capex will be funded mostly through internal accruals and will increase the manufacturing capacity of Performance Polymers business by 30,000 MT per annum.

risks_headwinds.claim: Uneven rainfall from an expected below-normal monsoon season may cause regional disruptions in Agri operating states.
Input costs may stay under pressure owing to ongoing geopolitical uncertainty.
Regulatory changes in FCO norms for Bio-stimulants reduced revenue and margins in the Agri Nutrient business.
Global market weakness placed industrial polymers under pressure.
risks_headwinds.quote: Industrial polymers remained under pressure due to global weakness; focus continues on adding new customers and portfolio expansion

risks_headwinds.claim: Replacement tyres and tyre cord fabrics faced a slowdown in both Indian and global markets.
risks_headwinds.quote: Replacement tyres and tyre cord fabrics experienced a slowdown in both global and Indian markets

risks_headwinds.claim: Global slowdown continued to create challenges for the industrial polymer business.
risks_headwinds.quote: Industrial polymer business continued to face challenges due to global slowdown.

risks_headwinds.claim: The food polymer business encountered a slowdown in the USA owing to tariff uncertainty.
risks_headwinds.quote: Food polymer business experienced a slowdown in the USA due to tariff uncertainty however company gained market share in other regions

risks_headwinds.claim: Operations faced a challenging macroeconomic environment and widespread heavy rainfall across India.
risks_headwinds.quote: Despite a challenging macroeconomic environment and widespread heavy rainfall across India, the company sustained double-digit revenue growth

management_commitments.claim: The company will commence its polymer adhesive manufacturing facility at Samlya, Gujarat in Q1 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Company will commence its state of the art Polymer (adhesive) manufacturing facility at Samlya ( Gujarat) in Q1 of FY27.

management_commitments.claim: Increased working capital deployment for off-season product placement is expected to be liquidated by Q1 FY27.
Pricing for Performance Polymers & Chemicals is expected to normalize by Q1 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Higher input costs for certain raw materials pressured EBITDA margins, but pricing is expected to normalize by Q1 FY27

management_commitments.claim: The company approved a ~ Rs. 50 Crs capex to set up new manufacturing facilities at Samlya, Vadodara to expand Performance Polymers capacity by 30,000 MT per annum.
management_commitments.quote: Board of Directors of the Company, at their meeting held on Tuesday, November 04, 2025 approved CAPEX of ~ Rs. 50 Crs for expansion of its Performance Polymers and Chemical segment by setting up new manufacturing facilities at its Samlya (Savli), Vadodara Gujarat site.

management_commitments.claim: The Board approved the Scheme of Arrangement for the demerger of its Agri Division into Jubilant Agri Solutions Limited with a share exchange ratio of 1:1.
management_commitments.quote: The Board of Directors of the Company at its meeting held on November 04, 2025, approved the Scheme of Arrangement for demerger of its Agri Division between Jubilant Agri and Consumer Products Limited (Demerged company) and Jubilant Agri Solutions Limited (Resulting Company).
